[quote=the_commonwealth_provisional_states;61601720]1. No, many countries are extremely resource-rich, but also some of the poorest nations in the world. Also, you don't have the resources you claim you do, your only major resources are gold and iron, and you do not have any energy resource deposits. Manufacturing is however, up to you but must be rped.

2. No, France and Germany have something (or rather are in something) called the European Union, which is by far the largest economic bloc in the entire world, an organization whose GDP has benefited from sigficantly by enabling mass trade of goods and services with all of Europe. You seemingly don't have anything like this, and therefore there economic situations do not apply to you

3. You have no manfacturing industry by your own admission, this already makes your chances of anything above a trillion GDP significantly low. Also, luxury goods are a manfacturing industry. 

4. Your "crazy expansion" is unlikely to be approved if it is truly that crazy.

5. Having an empire is expensive business, esspecially in the modern day, and would still weaken your case, just because you're large doesn't mean your economy is good (i.e Russia, the Congo, Brazil, Argentina). Esspecially if that size comes from disconnected colonies.

6. None of these are major resources that would explain your economy, sure, maybe in the 1700s-1800s but now those are quite common, and the countries that typically are responsible for producing most of those are quite poor. 

7. As the director of RP, no, you will not be keeping your economy. Continue on, and you may see more severe punishment. Don't think I have forgotten your blatant vandalism of government property. [/quote]

[quote=koranvistan;61596024]She chuckled and answered in fluent Corzerranean, [i]"Please, Marniy is fine."[/i] she smiled kindly, small lines showcasing that a smile was a habit, [i]"Have you been long in the country?"[/i][/quote]
(OOC:[nation]Corzerran[/nation] adding onto this now that I'm less illin-)
Marniy rested her hands on the counter while she listened to Cecilia. She had the same regal look as her daughter, and pointed ears to match that barely showed through thick, wavy hair.
Elena watched Cecilia and Marniy chat out of the corner of her eye while putting away the food they brought. She knew her love would make a good impression, but her Mama was one to chat. Marniy asked the usual questions, 'What do you do for work, Oh my a soldier!', and so on, all in all being very kind. Elena rejoined the conversation since everything was put away, giving Cecilia a peck on the cheek.
Veronika and Susana removed to the rear porch to smoke. It would be a couple of hours till their families came by. Veronika had brushed her hair, securing it with a few pins. She wore a dark, floral patterned skirt and a fur coat. Zana's hair was braided and topped with a fur hat, and she had a traditional dress + coat. Nika pulled two smokes from her pack, handing one to Zana and lighting her own.
[i]"Ah, the country air, almost free of millstink. It is nice, isn't it, Z?"[/i] she asked plainly.
[i]"You know I get so used to the air being poison, now that you mention it."[/i]
The two held straight faces before breaking into chuckles.
[i]"Maybe. Maybe we'll figure out if we're coming or going, but my job has been hard, Nashka,"[/i] Susana paused to take a drag, [i]"It's good to get away from it, but I'm wading through red tape! I mean running chemical waste through a leechfield, and that's normal out in Andrudin."[/i] she shook her head, pinching the bridge of her nose.
[i]"Propping up an illegal weapons exchange is a new one for me."
"Regime change has a complicated follow-through."[/i]
